description: This Java interface defines a builder for creating responses and events related to the ModifyFeatureProperty command within the Eclipse Ditto project. It includes nested interfaces for generating command responses (such as created, modified, or error responses) and for creating events triggered by the command (like feature property created or modified events).

classes.name: ModifyFeaturePropertyLiveCommandAnswerBuilder
classes.description: A builder interface for constructing command responses and events for the ModifyFeatureProperty command.

classes.name: ModifyFeaturePropertyLiveCommandAnswerBuilder.ResponseFactory
classes.description: Factory interface for creating command responses such as created, modified, or error responses.

classes.name: ModifyFeaturePropertyLiveCommandAnswerBuilder.EventFactory
classes.description: Factory interface for creating events triggered by the command, such as feature property creation or modification events.
